## What changes, and why? / Was aendert sich und warum?

## Actual verification / Tatsaechliche Pruefung
Name the command, environment and result. Do not replace failed tests with skipped tests.

## Safety boundary / Sicherheitsgrenze
Does this change target SQL, permissions, XML parsing, secret handling or workload semantics?

## Evidence / Belege
Attach synthetic or explicitly sanitized evidence only. State what remains untested.
